question.worked_solution:
We have a decoupled system. Therefore, the general solution is given by

$$
x(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{8t}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{-\sqrt{5}t},\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.
$$

Now, we need to find the values of ${c}_{1}$ and ${c}_{2}$ using the initial condition $x(0)=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 6\end{aligned}].$ Substituting $t=0$ into the general solution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}x(0) & ={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 6\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}{c}_{1} \\ {c}_{2}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to our initial value problem is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}x(t) & =(-3)\cdot [\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{8t}+6\cdot [\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{-\sqrt{5}t} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{8t}+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 6\end{aligned}]{e}^{-\sqrt{5}t}.\end{aligned}
$$
